map.自闭症光谱量表(AQ, Baron-Cohen 2001)，评估16岁以上具备正: Autism Spectrum Quotient (AQ, Baron-Cohen 2001) screens autistic traits in individuals aged 16+ with average intelligence. 50 items, 4-point scale, total 0-50. Score >=32 suggests clinically significant autistic traits; 26-31 indicates broad autism phenotype.
map.自闭症谱系商数(AQ) = Σ50个条目得分；按社交、沟通、想象、注意转换、细节: AQ = sum of 50 item scores, broken into factors: social skill, communication, imagination, attention switching and attention to detail; higher scores indicate more pronounced autistic traits.
map.提示临床显著自闭特质，建议专业评估: Suggests clinically significant autistic traits, professional evaluation advised
map.本量表为自助筛查工具，不能替代发育行为/精神科专业诊断。AQ适用于筛查，确诊需结: This scale is a self-help screening tool and does not replace developmental-behavioral or psychiatric diagnosis. AQ screens only; confirmation requires developmental history and clinical assessment.
map.📚 深度解析：AQ 孤独谱系: 📚 Deep Dive: AQ and the Autism Spectrum
map.50 题按 FWD 正向/反向计分：合计 32 ≥ 临界 32，提示孤独谱系特征: 50 items scored forward/reverse per FWD: total 32 >= cutoff 32, indicating marked autistic-spectrum features; ASD specialist assessment advised.
map.合计 18 分，未达阳性，但仍关注特定社交困难。: Total 18, below positive cutoff, but specific social difficulties still merit attention.
map.成人版常取 ≥32 为阳性界值；儿童/自评版阈值不同，结果仅供筛查。: Adult version commonly uses >=32 as the positive threshold; child/self-report thresholds differ; results are screening only.
map.AQ 为自评筛查，阳性仅提示需进一步 ADOS/ADI-R 等标准化评估。: AQ is a self-report screen; a positive result only indicates need for further standardized assessment such as ADOS/ADI-R.
map.关于「孤独症(AQ)自闭谱系评估器」: About the Autism Spectrum Quotient (AQ) Self-Assessment
map.孤独症(AQ)自闭谱系评估器。医疗专业工具，基于权威医学标准，仅供参考。: Autism Spectrum Quotient (AQ) Self-Assessment. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
